notes.title: Dungeon "Farming" rogue-like, The Sealed Ampoule Steam release confirmed!
notes.notes:
The Sealed Ampoule is built around the innovative concept of procedurally generated dungeon agriculture. The game is set in the same world as another CAVYHOUSE title, Forget Me Not: My Organic Garden, but ten years before the events of that game.

Forget Me Not: My Organic Garden: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/363980/Forget_Me_Not_My_Organic_Garden/

Development is moving at full speed towards release, in the meantime don't forget to add it to your wishlists!
